## Documentation

An incoming pre-checkout query from a buy button in an inline keyboard.

### Parameters

- **`id`** (`str`)
  Unique identifier for this query.

- **`from_user`** ([`User`](../user_and_chats/User.md))
  User who sent the query.

- **`currency`** (`str`)
  Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

- **`total_amount`** (`int`)
  Total price in the smallest units of the currency.

- **`payload`** (`str`)
  Bot specified invoice payload.

- **`shipping_option_id`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Identifier of the shipping option chosen by the user.

- **`payment_info`** ([`PaymentInfo`](../payments/PaymentInfo.md), *optional*)
  Payment information provided by the user.
